intro:
Welcome to Jelly Garden, a mesmerizing brain teaser that will leave you questioning your sanity. 
   Developed by GamePix, this addictive Arcade browser game is a puzzle lover's paradise, 
   where logic meets creativity and patience is tested to the limit. At its core, 
   Jelly Garden is a simple yet deceptively complex game of joining pieces to create a 
   cohesive whole, but don't let that fool you – it's anything but easy. As you progress 
   through increasingly challenging levels, you'll find yourself unraveling a web of 
   intricate puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Jelly Garden's 
   addictive nature is undeniable, and it's no wonder that players of all ages and skill 
   levels are flocking to it in droves. So, what makes this game so special? Let's dive 
   in and find out.


With its intuitive controls and user-friendly interface, 
   Jelly Garden is an absolute breeze to pick up and play. Whether you're using a 
   mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, the game responds seamlessly to your every 
   input. But make no mistake, this is a game that will put your wits to the test – be 
   prepared to scratch your head, rub your eyes, and question your life choices.


So, 
   what exactly is Jelly Garden, and why should you care? In a nutshell, it's a game 
   where you're presented with a grid of jelly pieces, each with its own unique shape and 
   color. Your goal is to join adjacent pieces by matching colors to create a single, 
   contiguous area. Sounds easy, right? Not so fast – as the levels progress, the 
   complexity increases, and you'll find yourself dealing with increasingly difficult 
   puzzles that require a deep understanding of spatial reasoning, pattern recognition, 
   and problem-solving skills. It's a true brain-twister, and one that will keep you 
   engaged for hours on end.


Jelly Garden's addictive nature is, in part, due to its 
   cleverly designed game mechanics. The game starts off relatively easy, with 
   straightforward puzzles that allow you to get a feel for the game's rhythm. However, 
   as you progress through the levels, the difficulty curve ramps up dramatically, and 
   you'll find yourself facing increasingly challenging puzzles that require a range of 
   skills and strategies. But don't worry – the game never feels overwhelming, and you 
   can always take a step back and regroup when needed.


One of the things that 
   sets Jelly Garden apart from other puzzle games is its unique visual style and 
   atmosphere. The game features a vibrant, colorful art style that's both visually 
   stunning and easy on the eyes. The jelly pieces are designed to be both cute and 
   intricate, making each level a delight to behold. But it's not just the visuals that 
   make Jelly Garden stand out – the game's atmosphere is equally impressive. With its 
   soothing background music and gentle sound effects, Jelly Garden is the perfect game 
   to play when you need to unwind and relax.


So, what are you waiting for? Join the 
   Jelly Garden revolution today, and get ready to have your mind blown by this 
   addictive puzzle game.

sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Jelly Garden is a game of joining pieces to create a cohesive whole. 
      The game presents you with a grid of jelly pieces, each with its own unique shape 
      and color. Your goal is to join adjacent pieces by matching colors to create a 
      single, contiguous area. Sounds easy, right? Not so fast – as the levels 
      progress, the complexity increases, and you'll find yourself dealing with 
      increasingly difficult puzzles that require a deep understanding of spatial 
      reasoning, pattern recognition, and problem-solving skills. The game's core 
      mechanics are simple yet deceptively complex, making it a true brain-twister.



      One of the things that sets Jelly Garden apart from other puzzle games is its 
      emphasis on spatial reasoning. The game requires you to think in three dimensions, 
      rather than just two, which adds an extra layer of complexity to the puzzles. 
      You'll need to rotate the grid, use mirrors to reflect pieces, and think outside 
      the box to solve each level. It's a true challenge, and one that will keep you 
      engaged for hours on end.


The game also features a range of tools and 
      techniques that you can use to aid you in your puzzle-solving journey. You can 
      rotate the grid, use the undo function to try again, and even use special power-
      up items to give you a boost. But don't worry – the game never feels 
      overpowered, and you'll still need to use your wits to solve each level. It's a 
      great balance of challenge and reward, and one that will keep you coming back 
      for more.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
If you're new to Jelly Garden, don't worry – it's easy to get started. Here are a 
      few beginner tips and tricks to help you get started:


Start with the easy 
      levels – they're a great way to get a feel for the game's rhythm and mechanics. 
      As you progress through the levels, the difficulty curve ramps up dramatically, 
      so it's a good idea to start with the easy stuff and work your way up.


Use the 
      undo function to try again – it's a great way to learn from your mistakes and 
      improve your skills. And don't be afraid to use the hint system if you get stuck 
      – it's a great way to get a nudge in the right direction.


Focus on one piece 
      at a time – it's easy to get overwhelmed by the sheer number of pieces on the 
      grid, but focusing on one piece at a time will help you stay focused and 
      organized. And don't forget to rotate the grid – it's a great way to see the game 
      from a different perspective and spot new opportunities.

sections.heading: Advanced Strategies
sections.body:
As you progress through the levels, you'll need to develop more advanced 
      strategies to succeed. Here are a few tips to help you take your game to the 
      next level:


Look for patterns and relationships between pieces – as you 
      progress through the levels, you'll start to notice patterns and relationships 
      between the pieces that will help you solve the puzzle. Look for groups of pieces 
      that are similar in shape or color, and try to find ways to connect them.


Use 
      the mirror tool to reflect pieces – the mirror tool is a great way to reflect 
      pieces and create new opportunities. Try using it to reflect a piece onto a 
      neighboring piece, or to create a new path for a piece to follow.


Look for 
      opportunities to chain pieces together – chaining pieces together is a great way 
      to create a contiguous area and solve the puzzle. Look for opportunities to 
      chain pieces together, and try to create long chains to maximize your score.

sections.heading: Game Modes and Features
sections.body:
Jelly Garden features a range of game modes and features that add to its replay 
      value. Here are a few of the game's key features:


Single-player mode – 
      compete against the clock to complete each level as quickly as possible. Leader-
      boards – compete with friends and other players to see who can complete each level 
      the fastest. Achievements – earn rewards and badges for completing levels, 
      achieving milestones, and improving your skills.


Multiplayer mode – compete 
      with friends and other players in real-time. The game features a range of multiplayer 
      modes, including online multiplayer and local multiplayer.


Level editor – 
      create your own levels and share them with the world. The game features a range of 
      tools and features that allow you to create your own levels, including a level 
      editor, a piece editor, and a scripting system.


Special power-up items – 
      earn special power-up items that will give you a boost and help you complete each 
      level. The game features a range of power-up items, including speed boosts, 
      extra lives, and special abilities.
